name: How long does bathroom waterproofing last?

mainEntity.name: How long does bathroom waterproofing last?

acceptedAnswer.text: Properly installed bathroom waterproofing, using quality materials, can last for many years, often exceeding the lifespan of the tiles themselves. The longevity depends on the type of membrane used, the quality of installation, and how well the bathroom is maintained. Typically, a well-executed waterproofing system can last 10-20 years or more, providing long-term protection against moisture penetration.
acceptedAnswer.description: With quality materials and proper installation, bathroom waterproofing can last 10-20 years or more, often outliving the tiles.
